# Henning Glerup

Henning Glerup is a Specialeansvarlig overlæge (specialist senior physician) at Region Midtjylland who serves as a steering committee member of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national quality registry for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1]. He represents both his region and the clinical leadership perspective within the governance structure of the registry.

Glerup's role reflects the registry's organizational model, which brings together clinical specialists from medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across all five Danish regions, coordinated by epidemiological and data management support from [[rkkp|RKKP]]. The DANIBD 2023 report documents the work of this steering committee during the period October 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, a period in which the registry tracked treatment for 33,381 patients with inflammatory bowel disease across the Danish healthcare system, including 10,523 patients who received biologic treatments [^src1].
